description: This Java class defines a type-safe, immutable wrapper for RPM values, providing methods for creating instances from an integer or string and for representing the RPM value as a string.

classes.name: RpmValue
classes.description: An immutable class that encapsulates an RPM value as a type-safe object.

methods.name: RpmValue
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RPM value.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the internal RPM value as an integer.

methods.name: valueOf
methods.description: Creates an RpmValue instance from a string representing an integer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the RPM value.
